title: TSAI Trust Authority HSM Attestation Payload
description: Decoded payload of the compact ES256 JWS published at /.well-known/tsai-ta-hsm-attestation (Section 7.11).

iss.description: Trust Authority issuer identifier; MUST equal the trusted TA iss

iat.description: Whole-second JWT NumericDate when the attestation was issued

exp.description: Whole-second attestation expiry; self-attestation MUST NOT exceed 30 days after iat

attestationType.description: Assurance level: independent audit, vendor attestation, or transitional self-attestation

auditor.description: Third party that performed the audit; required for independent-audit

auditDate.description: Date on which the audit or attestation evidence was established

auditStandard.description: Standard against which the audit was performed; required for independent-audit

scope.description: Signing-key generation, storage, and use covered by the evidence

reportDigest.description: SHA-256 integrity metadata over the exact audit-report bytes; required for independent-audit

reportUrl.description: Optional HTTPS location where the independent audit report can be requested; access need not be public or unauthenticated
